# watchpoint_maintenance_change_source (Resource)

Creates maintenance windows from approved ServiceNow or Jira change tickets delivered by signed webhook to `webhook_url`. Requires the maintenance calendar sync feature; creating and destroying need `settings.manage`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_maintenance_change_source" "jira" {
  kind            = "jira"
  name            = "Jira changes"
  scope_type      = "tag"
  scope_value     = "payments"
  approved_states = ["Approved", "Scheduled"]
  start_field     = "customfield_10020"
  end_field       = "customfield_10021"
}

# Configure these in Jira's webhook settings.
output "jira_webhook_url" {
  value = watchpoint_maintenance_change_source.jira.webhook_url
}

output "jira_webhook_secret" {
  value     = watchpoint_maintenance_change_source.jira.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) `servicenow` or `jira`. Changing it replaces the source (and its secret).
- `name` (String) Display name (120 characters max).
- `scope_type` (String) What the synced windows cover: `group`, `tag`, `service` or `monitors`.
- `scope_value` (String) The group ID, tag, service ID, or comma-separated monitor IDs, matching `scope_type`.

### Optional

- `approved_states` (Set of String) Ticket states that create or update a window. Defaults to `Scheduled`, `Implement` (ServiceNow) or `Approved`, `Scheduled`, `Implementing` (Jira).
- `cancelled_states` (Set of String) Ticket states that cancel the window. Defaults to `Canceled`, `Cancelled` (ServiceNow) or `Cancelled`, `Declined`, `Rejected` (Jira).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether syncing is on. Defaults to `true`.
- `end_field` (String) Ticket field holding the end time. ServiceNow defaults to `end_date`; required for Jira.
- `notify_on_end` (Boolean) Notify when a synced window ends. Defaults to `true`.
- `notify_on_start` (Boolean) Notify when a synced window starts. Defaults to `true`.
- `start_field` (String) Ticket field holding the start time. ServiceNow defaults to `start_date`; required for Jira (a custom field id such as `customfield_10020`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Source ID.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) HMAC signing secret the ticket system signs each webhook with. Returned only when the source is created, so it is kept in state (sensitive); an imported source has no secret here.
- `secret_hint` (String) Last characters of the signing secret.
- `webhook_url` (String) URL to configure in ServiceNow or Jira as the webhook target.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_maintenance_change_source.jira cts_0192f0c1
```
